tools.name: resolve_destination
tools.description: Find the Guestit destination for a place name before searching stays. Pass the place alone, such as Åre or Stockholm. Returns only places with Guestit stays, at most one. When nothing matches, ask the user about a larger place nearby.

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search public Guestit accommodation using a location_id from resolve_destination. Refine by resending the full filter set. tools.name: stay_details
tools.description: Read a public Guestit listing, house rules, cancellation policy and dated price estimate. Supply both dates and the guest count for an estimate. tools.name: compare_stays
tools.description: Compare two to four distinct Guestit listings for the same dates and number of guests. Retains missing or unavailable listings. Prices include applicable fees and do not hold inventory or confirm a booking.
